notes.title: [DEMO] Patch note for update 161120231100
notes.content:
New build with important changes: lives system (3 by default), extra level, multiple ship shapes, and time medals! 

[h2]➕ Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Biome selection
[*] New parallax background
[*] Extra level for demo
[*] Multiple ship shapes (one for each color)
[*] Lives system (3 by default, modifiable in settings)
[*] Floating particles in the background of levels
[*] Global leaderboard counting all level times
[*] Medals time for each level
[*] Show & update medal time below timer
[*] Medals displayed at a glance on level select
[*] Health indicator on player and on HUD
[/list]
[h2]🔨 Modifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] Remove “level” from level select numbers
[*] Smarter leaderboard display on clear level
[*] Better highlight system on leaderboard
[*] Highlight player on level leaderboard
[*] Display tapes collected at a glance on level select
[*] Animate stars & cassette on level select button
[*] New score & time font
[*] Damage VFX & SFX

[/list]
[h2]🐛 Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard level 1000 is shown as 0
[*] Shockwave on player shows a small dot when not used
[*] Obstacles can be double counted
[*] Can take damage when dead
[*] Best time is wrong on clear screen
[/list]

Enjoy 😎

notes.title: [DEMO] Patch note for update 171020231109
notes.content:
Here's a new update and a pretty cool one! Introducing leaderboards yaaay 🎉

[h2]➕ Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] WSAD can be used to navigate UI
[*] LB can be used to dash
[*] Remember last button focused on titlescreen
[*] Show last best time to compare with new best time
[*] Leaderboards on clear screen and standalone scene
[/list]
[h2]🔨 Modifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] Titlescreen, credits, controls, settings and level select share the same background
[*] Reduce timing between slice and obstacles part being pushed
[/list]
[h2]🐛 Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Trust sounds continues playing when level is cleared or player is dead
[*] Score calculated and saved are different than shown on clear screen 
[/list]

Enjoy and fill the leaderboards with amazing times 😎

notes.title: [DEMO] Patch note for update 131020231711
notes.content:
I didn't have time to put the patch note for Friday's build, so here it is! I can't link the patch note to the demo build unfortunately.

[h2]➕ Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quick restart with **select** or **R**
[/list]
[h2]🔨 Modifications[/h2]
[list]
[*] Apply window type after the game is loaded
[*] Start only general sound at 60%
[*] Hint at collectible tapes use
[/list]
[h2]🐛 Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Focus neighbor on sound sliders
[*] Weirdly placed spike on level 3
[*] Score restarts at more than 0
[*] Stats not filled in when showing the level
[*] Play last level doesn’t start at 0 when the save has been reset
[*] Start doesn’t play next level if last played is 0
[*] Level time is sometimes wrong after a retry
[*] Score is kept when going to next level
[*] Score hud is not reset to 0 when going to next level
[*] Score can count close calls when retrying
[/list]

Stay tuned for more!
